title: Now That’s Optimized!
description: Pure performance. No bloat. Just optimization.
body:
# Now That’s Optimized!

A lightweight Fabric optimization modpack focused entirely on FPS, faster loading, lower RAM usage, and smoother gameplay.

Tested in a normal environment with default RAM allocation, reaching around 1500-2500 FPS on Superflat worlds depending on hardware and settings.

Features
Faster chunk loading
Reduced stuttering
Better multiplayer performance
Lower memory usage
Faster startup times
Lightweight and stable

No content mods. No unnecessary features. Just performance.

---
### Community

If you find bugs, performance issues, or have suggestions, feel free to report them and help improve the pack.

Thanks to all mod developers included in this project.
